user.title: Site
user.description: Enter the values for this Home Assistant instance. Nothing is pre-filled from the integration. This instance's timezone is {ha_timezone}; type the IANA name you want on the devices.

data_description.site_name: A label for this fleet entry, shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.wifi_ssid: 2.4 GHz network. WPA3-only and 5 GHz-only networks will not join.
data_description.wifi_password: Stored on this config entry. It is not written to logs or diagnostics.
data_description.fleet_password: Optional. One admin password applied to each adopted device with Shelly.SetAuth. Leave blank to leave authentication off.
data_description.timezone: IANA name such as the zone configured on Home Assistant. Required; there is no built-in zone.

behaviour.title: Provisioning behaviour
behaviour.description: These are generic choices, not a site profile. Home Assistant's Shelly flow always turns the access point and Bluetooth RPC off after Wi-Fi provisioning. Uncheck those boxes to turn them back on afterwards. The Bluetooth scanner is separate and stays available for the proxy.

data.update_firmware: Update to stable firmware after adoption
data.require_allowlist: Only provision devices in the allowlist
data.ble_scanner_mode: Bluetooth scanner mode on each adopted Shelly

data_description.disable_ble_rpc: Bluetooth RPC is the setup channel. The advertisement proxy keeps working with RPC off.
data_description.require_allowlist: Leave this on unless you intend to adopt every factory-new Shelly that any proxy can hear.
data_description.ble_scanner_mode: Active asks nearby devices for full advertisements. Shelly proxies cannot open GATT connections.
data_description.concurrency: Keep this within the free connection slots of your connectable Bluetooth proxies. 2 is a safe start.
data_description.provisioning_minutes: How long the provisioning switch stays on. This is not the device's 15-minute setup window.

error.invalid_timezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone name.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.description: Leave the password blank to keep the one already stored on this entry.

security.title: Security and timezone
security.description: Leave the password blank to keep the stored fleet password. Leave the timezone blank to keep the stored zone.

inputs.title: Input profile
inputs.description: Applied to every channel when you adopt a device or run Apply profile. Turn the profile on or the fields are ignored. Per-device rows in the allowlist override these.

data_description.input_mode: Detached leaves the physical input independent of the relay or dimmer output. Momentary on a dimmer is sent as dim, because Light has no momentary mode.

outputs.title: Output profile
outputs.description: Power-on state and auto on/off timers. Match input applies to switches. Toggle applies to dimmers. A value the model rejects is skipped.

dimmers.title: Dimmer profile
dimmers.description: Fade rate is button_fade_rate (1 slow, 5 fast). Transition duration is the verified ramp, in seconds, from 0% to 100%. Separate up and down ramps are sent only when the device already exposes those fields. Power-on brightness is sent only when the component config already has a brightness field for it.

ble_window_closed.title: Shelly setup window is closed
ble_window_closed.description: {name} ({mac}) is advertising, but Bluetooth RPC is not available. Power-cycle it within range of a connectable Bluetooth adapter. Factory-new Gen2, Gen3, and Gen4 devices accept provisioning for about 15 minutes after power-on (about 3 minutes for battery devices). After the first IP address there is a further grace period of about 5 minutes, then Bluetooth RPC and the open access point close.

apply_profile.name: Apply profile
apply_profile.description: Apply the fleet security and channel profile to Shelly devices already added by the core Shelly integration. Devices that already have authentication are updated only with the password stored on their Shelly entry. Their password is not replaced.
